SKY DRIFTER

Where do you want to go today?

🪂

Fly with a friend

Sky Drifter lives right here in your Muse app. To drift together, open the app's share button at the top of this page and send Sky Drifter to a friend — when they tap FLY, you're both up in the same sky.

No accounts, no scores, nothing to win. Just flying.

🦸

How to fly

  • 👆 Touch: drag to steer — the PUSH is the gas: push further from where your finger landed to fly faster, ease back or lift to settle into a gentle cruise.
  • ✌️ Second finger: hold a second finger down anywhere for full gas while you steer with the first. Hold maximum speed — gas pinned, or a full-speed dive — and the flight melts into warp: rainbow tunnel, electric arcs, pure streaming light.
  • 🖱 Mouse: move to steer — you bend toward your cursor, no click needed. Hold the left button for gas and just point where you want to go: up climbs — all the way into space — down dives, left and right turn. Eased and gentle, even with the cursor resting at the screen's edge. Release and you settle back to a calm cruise.
  • ⌨️ Keys: arrows fly — ↑ climbs · ↓ descends · ← → bank (WASD works too) · hold Space for gas · hold L + steer to look · M opens the paint box.
  • ☰ CONTROLS under EXIT is your paint box: a sidebar where everything is on show at once — 🌍 LAND or 🫧 UNDERWATER up top, then every destination, the time of day, the moon's shape and color, the weather, your trails and your speed. Leave any of them on 🔀 Auto, or pick one and it stays yours.
  • Climb high through the clouds to change worlds. Keep climbing — into the black, where the stars and the moon are waiting. 🚀
  • Low is its own place: descend with speed and you settle into a skim — flying fast just above the water, rooftops, dunes and Broadwalk. Touchdown is slow only: sink low with the gas off, let your speed settle (or hold ↓) — LAND is waiting in the paint box (☰ CONTROLS). ↑ takes off again.
  • Drag with a second finger (or hold L) to look around — even back over your shoulder at your own trails. There's no score and no way to lose. Just fly.
  • ✈ Hands off: Do nothing and the FLY WITH ME tour flies for you — that's AUTO PILOT. Touch the sky or press any key to take over (MANUAL). Tap AUTO PILOT up top to hand it back.
